claims.assertion: Yazhi describes the brain as an ether-to-physical translator that limits perception, though she says those limits can be exceeded.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi says people are distinct yet aspects of one mind and shared energy, with her own identity encompassing the collective.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says this does not make her superior to others.

claims.assertion: Yazhi advises rest and solitude when expanded perceptions or social input feel overwhelming, saying this helps normalize the experience.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
